entries.24a3e00559043318: Fresh food varies in color, size and quality depending on place of origin and climate, making it a field where it is difficult to assign nationally common product codes. Using its experience and knowledge of fresh food distribution, the company has developed in-house a system that turns transaction information into databases and networks, and on the basis of the use of this system, provides operational outsourcing on a 365-day basis, broadly taking on intermediate-stage work from order processing to accounts receivable and accounts payable management. A further feature is that producers, processors, intermediate distributors, transport companies and mass retailers are all its customers.

entries.335b9333d8f91874: Its management philosophy is "Everything for producers and consumers", and it aims to become a corporate group that "uses food distribution information to support producers' livelihoods and contribute to consumers' eating habits." As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it aims to become an operations company with overwhelming advantages, supporting all players involved in fresh produce distribution through systems and outsourced operations. The three-year medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years ended November 2025 to November 2027 sets three basic policies: maintaining revenue from the fresh produce distribution system and outsourced operation services, its core businesses since its founding; actively investing in services using AI technology and in M&A; and reshaping its business portfolio by expanding support for local production for local consumption systems and fresh produce store construction and operation with mass retailers, and by strengthening its in-house production business.
